Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Oliver Kevor re-elected NDC Eastern Regional Chairman Source : myjoyonline.com 15 November 2026 5:36am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Ing. Dr Mark Oliver Kevor will continue to lead the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Eastern Region after retaining his position as Regional Chairman in the party’s executive elections.
Ahead of the polls, Dr Kevor identified grassroots mobilisation and the strengthening of party structures as key priorities for his next term, saying he wanted to position the region as an NDC stronghold.
He outlined a constituency-by-constituency and branch-by-branch strategy to expand the party’s presence and improve its organisation across the region.
“Our goal must be clear: to turn the Eastern Region green, constituency by constituency and branch by branch,” he stated.
Dr Kevor also pointed to his experience working with the late Dr Edward Omane Boamah as an influence on his approach to political organisation, highlighting the value of data, discipline, strategic planning and attention to detail.
His re-election offers him another opportunity to implement the agenda and strengthen the NDC’s grassroots presence in the Eastern Region.
